description: Combat copy of the formation lab (game designer decisions 2026-11-01, docs/design/COMBAT_LAB.md; built by Scripts/Editor/build_formation_lab.py from Content/Data/FormationLab/Combat/formation_lab_combat_01.json = the lab layout + 4 towers with ladders). The squad meets endless enemy pressure: the first group at 30 s, then every 2 minutes a group of 1-3 (Hound, Frostbitten, Military Zombie, Cutter, Marksman; the Military Zombie replaced the Spitter, task #34 2026-11-07) - a patrol walking a loop or ambushers hidden at wall ends / doorways / the authored ambush points near the squad's way that strike when their side is unwatched; some ambushes are coordinated plans of 4-6 (flanks first, then rear + front, ranged ones suppress; their own alive cap 6); a bypassed ambush runs a concealed route on foot to a new spot ahead (spotted on the way it attacks; no concealed route: it stays, then follows the squad as a patrol), an ambush watched all along strikes after 60-90 s, hiding spots hug the wall (0.8 m). Fights start on contact (combat_start ambush) as skirmishes and end straight in exploration. No cold, no intro briefing, no horde; the squad is immortal with infinite ammo by default (Codex.Cheat.Immortal / Codex.Cheat.InfiniteAmmo 0 turn them off). ONE small wave only because the level file must hold a valid wave (CodexTactics.LevelJson.AllFilesParse); it is never played (the fights are skirmishes).

bot_route.name: combat_lab_loop_01
bot_route.comment: The playtest bot's planned route (Training Ground 'Combat lab', game designer 2026-11-01: every map has a route; docs/design/COMBAT_LAB.md section 7). A loop from the spawn through the lab: tower T_SW, the W_C_4 corner, tower T_NW, the inner corner of lane E, the V2 6 m doorway, the W_E_14 end, tower T_NE, a wall hug at W_G_20, tower T_SE, both lane D corridors, the lane C 2 m doorway, a wall hug at W_B_2 and its west end. 'wall' = a click on the wall face at 'wall' (the formation wall layout), 'climb' = the leader alone climbs the nearest tower ladder and back. ~453 m a lap.
